findings.why_it_is_a_defect: ParentView creates a new model on body recomputation while @ObservedObject does not provide owned stable storage, so model state/subscriptions/task lifetime can reset.
findings.recommended_change: Give the model one explicit stable owner using SwiftUI-owned state or child ownership; keep @ObservedObject for stable injection.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: Confirmed from the call site; intended lifetime is unspecified.

findings.why_it_is_a_defect: Changing between non-nil item IDs can retain structural view identity, leaving the unkeyed task associated with stale item/model work.
findings.recommended_change: Use .task(id: itemID) and make load cancellation/generation-aware.
findings.authority_or_scope_note: Confirmed from identity/task spans; load implementation is not shown.

controls_not_defects: @ObservedObject itself is valid with stable parent-owned injection; $model.name is not independently defective.
unknowns: DetailModel implementation and stale-completion behavior are not supplied.
